_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Historical 2009–2014 source snapshot from DOJ indictment and 15-defendant release, one DOJ sentencing release, and two federal court opinions. All 15 profiles are explicitly listed as charged defendants in the 20 November 2009 DOJ release; named wholesalers only appearing in the main indictment narrative are excluded unless that release also lists them as defendants. Twelve 2009 charged statuses are historical and do not assert that charges remain pending today. Three people have later individually verified guilty pleas; only Gonzalez-Zavala has a verified sentence in the reviewed releases. Person links come from direct named interactions in the indictment and remain labeled allegations. United States means a source-backed operating country for the Chicago case; Mexico is cartel context and is not assigned to individual profiles. No exact locations, operational routes, live whereabouts, or unlicensed photos.
